svg.title: speakON NL4 — review study
svg.desc: Removed fictitious XLR-like holes; restored protected annular twist-lock face and keyed central bore from NL2MP/NL4MP/NL8MPR photographs. Contacts are hidden in frontal view, not drawn as an invented radial pinout. Manufacturer counts are 2/4/8; NL8 uses a larger square four-hole flange. Exact catalogue variant remains unresolved. Original WireNexus thumbnail compared visually; existing SVG inspected at 32, 64 and 128 px. Manufacturer photograph inspected: protected annular twist-lock interface; 2/4/8 internal contacts as named, not an XLR-like ring of holes. Exact source generation/finish not supplied. Hidden electrical contacts are intentionally not depicted as a guessed frontal pinout.
